Resources

  • What is DNS A record? - The A Record points your hostname to an IP address. This is one of the most frequently used records in the DNS Zones.
  • What is PTR record? - PTR records are used for the Reverse DNS (Domain Name System) lookup. Using the IP address you can get the associated domain/hostname.
  • What is the CNAME record? - The CNAME record is also known as a canonical name record. It is used for specifying that a domain name is an alias for another domain, the "canonical" domain.
  • Master DNS zone - The Master Zone also known as Primary Zone in the DNS server is the read or write copy of the DNS database.
  • Slave DNS zone - The Slave/Backup DNS zone also known as Secondary is the read-only copy of the DNS records. This means that the DNS records cannot be added directly to the Slave/Backup DNS zone.
  • What is a DNS query? - A DNS query (also known as a DNS request) is a demand for information sent from a user's computer (DNS client) to a DNS server.

Enhancing Performance and Speed for a Leading Trading Platform with GeoDNS

2024-10-22

In today's fast-paced financial markets, the speed and reliability of a trading platform can make or break the user experience. The ability to deliver real-time data and seamless transactions is essential for traders to make informed decisions. In 2019, a leading European trading platform sought out ClouDNS to upgrade its infrastructure, enhance the speed of its services, and improve its real-time performance. They needed a solution that could handle high volumes of data while optimizing the user experience for their growing client base. This case study explores how ClouDNS played a critical role in helping the platform meet and exceed its goals.

Challenges

The trading platform contacted ClouDNS in 2019, facing several challenges. The company had already built a solid reputation in the industry but wanted to further improve their service. They identified several critical areas that needed enhancement:

Sluggish Performance: In financial trading, even the slightest delay in processing data can lead to lost opportunities or unfavorable trades. Their existing infrastructure struggled to handle the growing number of users and transactions, leading to latency issues and slower performance, which impacted the overall user experience.

Poor Real-Time Data Delivery: The platform needed to ensure it could deliver financial market data in real-time to its users without any lag. The financial markets operate in real-time, and delays or downtime in processing market updates could have significant financial consequences for their clients.

Scalability Concerns: As the platform continued to grow in terms of popularity, they expected a significant increase in their user base. Their existing system wasn't capable of scaling efficiently to accommodate this growth.

The company knew they needed a robust DNS solution that could handle the increased traffic, process requests faster, and improve the real-time performance of their platform. They also needed a reliable partner who understood the importance of speed and accuracy in financial services.

Our solution

The ClouDNS team thoroughly analyzed the trading platform's needs in order to tailor the most suitable solution. We proposed implementing GeoDNS targeting, which is designed to optimize DNS request handling by directing users to the nearest DNS server based on their geographical location. It significantly reduces latency and speeds up the processing of data, providing the fast and responsive experience users expect from a top-tier trading platform. Key improvements from our GeoDNS solution included:

Faster Request Processing: By utilizing GeoDNS targeting, the platform was able to route user requests to the closest server geographically. This significantly reduced latency, ensuring that users received faster responses to their actions, such as executing trades or pulling market data.

Enhanced User Experience: Faster request processing directly translated to a more seamless and intuitive user experience. Traders experienced quicker data loads and smoother transactions, which are critical in a competitive trading environment.

Real-Time Data Performance: The core requirement for any trading platform is to deliver financial data as it happens in real-time. With the integration of GeoDNS, the platform was able to deliver live market updates to its users without delay, ensuring that traders could make decisions based on the most current information available.

Scalability and Reliability: The GeoDNS solution allowed the platform to scale its infrastructure efficiently. As more users joined the platform, the system could handle the increased traffic with ease. Additionally, by distributing traffic across multiple geographic nodes, the platform became more resilient to potential server outages and other technical issues.

The GeoDNS solution helped improve the platform's performance, ensuring traders received market updates in real time and could execute transactions faster than before.

Client Success Story

The collaboration between ClouDNS and the trading platform delivered immediate and ongoing results. Only two years after implementing the GeoDNS solution from ClouDNS, in 2021, the trading platform experienced massive growth. Their improved performance led to a significant increase in customer satisfaction.

Most notably, they experienced rapid growth, doubling their client base due to the enhanced user experience and real-time market data accessibility. The increased traffic and demand prompted the trading platform to upgrade its GeoDNS plan to adapt to its larger user base.

Thanks to ClouDNS's scalable GeoDNS solution, the trading platform was able to accommodate its growing user base with ease. Today, the platform is recognized as one of the top trading platforms in Europe. It offers traders an incredibly fast, efficient, and user-friendly experience, allowing them to make trades with confidence and precision.

In brief

  • Core business: Trading Platform
  • Challenges: Sluggish performance, poor real-time data delivery, scalability concerns as the user base grew.
  • Solution: ClouDNS provided a GeoDNS solution to optimize request handling by routing users to the nearest server, improving speed and reducing latency. This solution enhanced real-time data delivery, improved user experience, and ensured scalability.
  • Results: The platform doubled its client base by 2021, delivering faster trades and seamless market updates, securing its place as a top-tier trading platform in Europe.

Who we are?

ClouDNS is provider of global Managed DNS services, including GeoDNS, Anycast DNS and DDoS protected DNS. The company implements the industry's leading cloud service architecture for maximum DNS speed and DNS redundancy. ClouDNS platform monitors, controls and optimizes applications and DNS infrastructure, ensuring traffic gets delivered faster, safer, and more reliably than ever.

Founded in 2010, ClouDNS services have grown to manage hundreds of thousands of customer domains receiving more than 8 billion queries per day. ClouDNS is the preferred DNS hosting choice for many brands, especially companies who closely monitor the price–performance ratio. Improving Precision and Performance for VoIP Service with GeoDNS

2024-03-26

In the fast-paced world of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) services, a reliable and swift DNS (Domain Name System) is the backbone that ensures seamless communication. Recognizing the critical importance of DNS, an Australian VoIP provider approached ClouDNS at the end of 2018, seeking a dynamic solution to enhance their services.

VoIP is a technology that is heavily dependent on speed, reliability, and constant uptime. Therefore, it demands a DNS hosting provider that could meet these strict requirements. In this case study, we dive into the challenges faced by our client and how ClouDNS managed to help and support their remarkable growth.

Challenges

In 2018, our client, a prominent VoIP provider in Australia, faced a critical decision point. They were standing at a crossroads, dealing with multiple options and unsure about which path to take. The future of their business hung in the balance, and the stakes were high.

Their search for a new DNS service provider originated from the necessity to improve GeoDNS capabilities. The client explicitly expressed the need to direct users to the right country based on their IP address, a crucial feature to optimize service quality.

The Australian VoIP provider had encountered several challenges with their previous DNS service provider. Despite offering a similar service, the provider was rather expensive and could not provide the accurate precision needed for GeoDNS targeting in Australia. Furthermore, the absence of a redundant Anycast network resulted in prolonged DNS query responses, which is a significant drawback for a VoIP provider striving for speed and constant uptime.

Competing in a market demanding high speed and reliability, the client faced the challenge of maintaining competitive prices while providing top-notch services. The existing infrastructure costs were proving to be a barrier to growth, prompting the search for a more efficient DNS solution.

Our solution

ClouDNS stepped in to address the VoIP provider's challenges with a comprehensive solution tailored to its specific needs. The introduction of our GeoDNS service not only met but exceeded the client's expectations, providing greater quality at a more competitive price point.

The precision of GeoDNS targeting ensured that users from Australia and other targeted regions were seamlessly directed to the nearest and most reliable servers, optimizing their VoIP experience. In addition, combined with the robustness of our redundant Anycast network, it ensured minimal downtime and improved overall performance.

The ClouDNS support team worked closely with the client and played a pivotal role in optimizing the DNS configuration for the VoIP provider. With expert guidance and assistance, the client efficiently configured numerous DNS records, streamlining its operations and enhancing overall service efficiency. The seamless integration of ClouDNS's services enabled the provider to focus on its core business activities while assigning the critical aspect of DNS management to a reliable partner.

Client Successful story

Empowered by ClouDNS's GeoDNS service, the Australian VoIP provider experienced remarkable business growth. The ability to precisely target users in Australia based on their IP addresses significantly improved the overall performance of the VoIP services, meeting the high requirements for speed and reliability.

As the business grew, the client expanded into new markets, offering services in countries like New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and Canada. The seamless integration of ClouDNS services allowed the client to effortlessly extend its geographical reach, catering to a broader audience without compromising on performance.

Responding to the increasing demand for services, the client decided to upgrade the plan with ClouDNS, obtaining additional resources to support the growing infrastructure. This not only ensured continued high performance and amazing precision but also demonstrated the scalability and flexibility of ClouDNS services.

Moreover, the client took advantage of ClouDNS's Reverse DNS service to manage different IP subnets efficiently. This strategic move further streamlined operations and enhanced the overall efficiency of the client's network infrastructure.

In brief

  • Core business: VoIP service provider
  • Challenges: Needed to enhance GeoDNS capabilities for precise targeting based on IP addresses. Previous provider was expensive, lacked accurate GeoDNS precision, and had prolonged DNS query responses.
  • Solution: Tailored GeoDNS solution, exceeding expectations. Enhanced precision, lowered costs, and minimized downtime with redundant Anycast network.
  • Results: The VoIP provider experienced remarkable business growth. Improved service in Australia and expanded into new markets.
